expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of T cells (cytotoxic), as scattered single cells through tumour and stroma, denser in immune-rich regions and lymphoid aggregates; a minority of all cells, sitting on CD3+ cells, with dim NK/DC cells allowed.
observed: A: discrete yellow dots in every image, dense in immune-rich images and sparse in others. B/C: a few ringed cells on dark tissue, no haze. D: membrane rings. E: a dense field of crisp ringed cells, many white in the merge (on CD3); some are green-only.
why: A distinct population of cells with membrane rings, at different densities across the images, sits largely on CD3+ cells, with low background and no haze or texture following the tissue.
notes: CD8a marks crisp membrane rings on scattered cells, dense in immune-rich images and sparse elsewhere. In the CD3-dense field many of them overlap CD3 (white in the merge). The background stays dark.
